fields.Fee Scope: Net academic semester charges excluding ₹10,000 refundable security. Application ₹1,500, hostel and living costs extra.

fields.Eligibility: 2026–28: bachelor’s degree (3/4/5-year integrated); 60% each in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation; freshers or under 3 years work experience on 30 June 2026; degree completion proof by 30 Nov 2026.
fields.Selection Process: Shortlist by academic documents and best submitted entrance score; shortlisted candidates take written ability test and personal interview, then receive offer.
